name: lidarr-similar
description: Discovers artists similar to your Last.fm listening history and helps you add them to Lidarr. Candidates come from Last.fm's artist.getSimilar and Deezer's related-artist data (boosted when both sources agree), optionally enriched with Discogs genre/style metadata and two popularity signals - Deezer fan count and ListenBrainz listener count. A web dashboard lets you review candidates, filter by minimum score, sort by popularity, ignore artists or whole genres, and add artists to Lidarr with one click.

paths.name: AppData
paths.description: Persists the SQLite store (discovery results, ignore lists, saved settings) and enrichment cache across container updates.

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: Port the lidarr-similar web dashboard listens on.

variables.name: LASTFM_API_KEY
variables.description: Last.fm API key - create one at last.fm/api/account/create

variables.name: LASTFM_USERNAME
variables.description: Last.fm username to read scrobbles/similar-artist data from

variables.name: LIDARR_URL
variables.description: Base URL of your Lidarr instance, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8686 - optional, but required for library dedup and the Add to Lidarr button

variables.name: LIDARR_API_KEY
variables.description: Lidarr API key (Settings -> General) - optional, same requirement as LIDARR_URL

variables.name: LIDARR_ROOT_FOLDER
variables.description: Root folder path Lidarr should use for newly added artists, e.g. /music - required for the Add to Lidarr button

variables.name: LIDARR_QUALITY_PROFILE_ID
variables.description: Numeric Lidarr quality profile ID - easier to leave blank and set via the app's /config page, which shows a dropdown of your Lidarr instance's actual profile names

variables.name: LIDARR_METADATA_PROFILE_ID
variables.description: Numeric Lidarr metadata profile ID - same as above, easier to set via the /config page dropdown

variables.name: DISCOGS_TOKEN
variables.description: Discogs personal access token (discogs.com/settings/developers) - optional, enables genre/style/release-year enrichment

variables.name: DEEZER_ENABLED
variables.description: Enable Deezer as a similarity source and popularity signal (true/false)

variables.name: AUTH_PASSWORD
variables.description: Password-protects the web UI - leave blank to keep it open with no login, same as before this option existed

variables.name: AUTH_SKIP_LOCAL
variables.description: Skip the login page for requests from private/loopback addresses (e.g. your own LAN) even when AUTH_PASSWORD is set (true/false)
